RagaM-Roll — raga notations?

Auto-detected Carnatic raga notations (arohana/avarohana and signature phrases). Audio is not hosted here — these are the notations, not the recordings. Each raga is drawn as one octave of keys, S to S, with its swaras in the keys they occupy: wires over the top are the ārohaṇa, under the bottom the avarohaṇa, each arriving at the key it lands on — so a vakra raga's backward step shows as a wire running the other way. A split key means the two commas of one semitone, and the raga's letter sits in the one it takes. Open a raga in draw to see its roll, hear the notes and their gamakas, and edit them. Drafts from a native pitch-detection pipeline — expect rough spots; ⚠ check Sa marks likely tonic/octave issues.
